distance.doc: Maximum distance within which points are snapped and fused

fuse_points.doc: Consolidate and weld merged points into a single point (false snaps positions only)

group.doc: Subset of points to snap or fuse

outgrp_fused.doc: Create a point group containing fused points

outgrp_fused_name.doc: Name of the group for fused points

outgrp_unique.doc: Create a point group containing unique points

outgrp_unique_name.doc: Name of the group for unique points

output_positions.doc: Position for fused points: position of first point or average of cluster

remove_unused_points.doc: Discard points not referenced by any primitive after fusing

snap_to.doc: Snap method: cluster near points or snap to 3D grid
